title: Design System: Open Finance — The Vault

display.purpose: Engraved plate headings — page titles, auth door, wordmark. Always uppercase, 0.08em tracking.

headline.purpose: Fixed identity plates — account names, dialog titles. Uppercase, 0.06em tracking.

title.purpose: The .plate-label engraving — card titles, field markings, date-group headers. Inter 600, 11px, 0.18em, uppercase, debossed.

instrument.purpose: Every monetary amount — tabular-nums, 44px/700 master readout down to 14px/600 rows.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: Plate at rest — default cards, the master plate. Bevel highlight + tight contact shadow.

shadows.name: plate-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifted plate — hover states, dialogs, the vault-door login plate, highlighted rows.

shadows.name: slot
shadows.purpose: Machined slot — recessed inputs, progress tracks, active nav wells, icon tiles.

shadows.name: lock-halo
shadows.purpose: The One Halo — engaged privacy-lock glow. The only glow in the system.

shadows.name: drag-state
shadows.purpose: Dashboard card in the pointer's grip — brass state ring plus deep contact shadow.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default arrival easing — pages, staggers, bolt-slide, progress.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Page entrances, staggered rows, grid reflow.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: The bolt-slide privacy lock — the world's one authored motion.

motion.name: bolt-slide
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0 0 0 0) with translateX(-4px → 0); 420ms expo; stagger min(index × 35ms, 280ms)
motion.purpose: Masking slides shut like a bolt across every PrivateAmount on the page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one brass action — machined gradient with inset bevel; presses down on active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e3c06a, #c5a254); color: #1a1408; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.28), 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); transition: all 150ms ease-in-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.07); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.95); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(197 162 84 / 0.7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lifted steel plate with a strong hairline rim — the everyday action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1b1f24; color: #eceff2; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #39414b; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); transition: all 150ms ease-in-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #262c33; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(197 162 84 / 0.7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent until hovered — used for row actions and icon buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #eceff2; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: all 150ms ease-in-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #14171b; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(197 162 84 / 0.7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Plate Card
components.description: A machined steel plate — hairline bevel, tight contact shadow, engraved caps title.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #14171b; border: 1px solid #262c33; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045), 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), 0 12px 28px -20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7); transition: all 200ms ease-out; max-width: 320px; } .ds-card:hover { background: #1b1f24; border-color: #39414b; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06), 0 2px 4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), 0 20px 44px -20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #89929d; text-shadow: 0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-card-amount { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #eceff2; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #a5aeb8; margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Slot Input
components.description: Recessed machined groove; brass ring on focus, oxblood on error.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgb(12 14 16 / 0.6); color: #eceff2; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #262c33; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); transition: all 150ms; width: 260px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7d8691; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #39414b; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #262c33; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03), 0 0 0 2px #0c0e10, 0 0 0 4px #c5a254; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Tint-and-rim status plate — bg/10 fill, status text, /30 hairline.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.025em; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-badge-success { background: rgb(61 178 142 / 0.1); color: #3db28e; border: 1px solid rgb(61 178 142 / 0.3); } .ds-badge-error { background: rgb(224 115 104 / 0.1); color: #e07368; border: 1px solid rgb(224 115 104 / 0.3); }

components.name: Nav Item (Active)
components.description: The machined well with a brass index pin — the vault index's active mark.
components.html: DashboardAccounts
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #0c0e10; padding: 12px; width: 240px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; border-right: 1px solid #262c33; } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #a5aeb8; text-decoration: none; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #eceff2; background: #14171b; } .ds-nav-active { color: #eceff2; background: #14171b; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); height: 60%; width: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e3c06a, #c5a254); }

components.name: Period Selector
components.description: Recessed well of preset pills; the active preset is the brass hardware chip.
components.css: .ds-period { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #14171b; border: 1px solid #262c33; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); } .ds-period-btn { padding: 6px 12px; min-height: 36px; min-width: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #a5aeb8; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-period-btn:hover { background: #1b1f24; color: #eceff2; } .ds-period-on { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e3c06a, #c5a254); color: #1a1408; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.28); } .ds-period-on:hover { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e3c06a, #c5a254); color: #1a1408; }

components.name: Progress Groove
components.description: Machined slot track with a brass fill scaling on transform.
components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; height: 8px; width: 260px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0c0e10; border: 1px solid #262c33; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; width: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: #c5a254; transform-origin: left center; transform: scaleX(0.62); transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }

components.name: Vault-Wheel Logomark
components.description: The identity glyph — machined brass dial with index ticks, three spokes, and a hub. Never recolor or restyle.

narrative.overview:
Opening the app is opening the vault. The interface is the user's own safe-deposit room: cool charcoal-steel grounds, machined plates with hairline bevels, engraved labels, aged-brass hardware, and instrument numerals calibrated like a bank gauge. It refuses the flat-black fintech card grid where every card shouts the same neon accent — here, one warm metal speaks, and only when it matters.

Density is instrument-grade: compact rows, tabular numerals, engraved caps for plate titles, and a single authored motion (the bolt-slide) reserved for the one mechanical master lock — the amounts privacy toggle. The master plate carries the net-worth readout behind a guilloché security rosette; every account is a labeled deposit box; the sidebar is the vault index. Dark is the world's own scene — the safe-deposit room under its lamp — and the light theme is the same room with the lamp switched on (brushed aluminum daylight), with full token parity including the shadow vocabulary.
keyCharacteristics: One warm metal rule: aged brass (#c5a254 dark / #7d6118 light) is hardware only — primary actions, locks, active marks, focus rings
Machined elevation: bevel-edge highlight + tight contact shadow (shadow-plate), never a wide diffuse halo; inset shadow-slot for grooves
Engraved voices: Marcellus roman caps for plate titles/wordmark, 11px debossed plate-label caps for field markings
Instrument numerals: JetBrains Mono tabular-nums for every amount on the page
Palette re-voicing: legacy Tailwind green/red/yellow/blue/gray steps are remapped into the mineral family at the token level, so every gain/loss/info surface speaks steel-and-brass
The bolt-slide: the world's one authored motion, masking/unmasking amounts with a staggered clip-path sweep
Browser-surface theming: theme-color #0c0e10, color-scheme dark — the vault extends past the viewport edge

rules.name: The One Metal Rule
rules.body: Brass is hardware: primary actions, locks, active marks, focus rings, the logomark. It never appears as decorative fill, chart series dominance, or large background tint. Its rarity is the point — on any given screen brass should touch ≤10% of the pixels.

rules.name: The Palette Re-Voicing Rule
rules.body: Never introduce raw Tailwind green/red/yellow/blue/gray hex values. The legacy scale steps themselves are remapped into the mineral family in @theme, so text-green-600, bg-red-500/10, ring-blue-500 all resolve to vault pigments automatically. New code uses the semantic tokens (success, error, warning, accent-blue).

rules.name: The Daylight Parity Rule
rules.body: Every token overridden in :root.light must stay a complete set — surfaces, text, status, shadcn aliases, and all three shadows. A token that only exists in dark is a bug; the light theme is the same room with the lamp on, not a second design.

rules.name: The Instrument Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every monetary amount on the page renders in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums — no exceptions, including deltas, projections, and converted-currency tooltips. Proportional digits in an amount is a defect.

rules.name: The Engraved Caps Rule
rules.body: Plate titles and identity plates are uppercase with wide tracking (0.06–0.18em) — Marcellus for named things (pages, accounts, dialogs), Inter 600 for anonymous markings (field labels, card titles). Sentence-case titles on a plate break the world.

rules.name: The Machined Depth Rule
rules.body: Every elevated surface uses shadow-plate/shadow-plate-lift; every recessed surface uses shadow-slot. Do not introduce ad-hoc shadow-lg/shadow-xl diffusion — depth comes from bevel + contact, not blur radius.

rules.name: The One Halo Rule
rules.body: The only glow in the system is the engaged privacy lock's brass halo. Status, focus, and hover states use brightness shifts, bevel changes, or hairline color — not box-shadow glows.

dos: Do render every amount in JetBrains Mono tabular-nums (font-mono / .number-display) — the Instrument Numerals Rule.
Do use shadow-plate / shadow-plate-lift / shadow-slot for all depth; reach for the tokens, not ad-hoc shadows.
Do title plates and named entities in uppercase Marcellus (font-display uppercase tracking-[0.06em]) and anonymous markings in .plate-label.
Do express status with the tint-and-rim formula (bg-{status}/10 text-{status} border-{status}/30).
Do keep brass on hardware only — primary actions, active marks, the lock, focus rings (One Metal Rule).
Do override the full token set when touching :root.light, including all three shadows (Daylight Parity Rule).
Do use the motion tokens (--ease-out-expo, --duration-fast/normal/slow) and respect the prefers-reduced-motion block, which collapses travel to 1ms while keeping state changes.
Do reuse the engraving kit (.bg-guilloche, .plate-label, .hairline-brass) instead of new ornament.
donts: Don't introduce raw Tailwind palette hexes (green-500, red-600, blue-400…) — the scale steps are re-voiced to mineral pigments at the token level; use semantic tokens.
Don't add diffuse halo shadows or glow states (except the one lock halo); depth is bevel + contact, never blur.
Don't use Marcellus for body copy, lowercase text, or numerals — it is engraved caps only.
Don't give charts a dominant neon accent; series come from the desaturated mineral set in src/constants/colors.ts.
Don't add a second authored motion or animation signature; the bolt-slide is the world's one mechanical moment, and standard entrances already exist (.page-enter, .stagger-item, .pop-enter).
Don't round cards to pill shape or sharpen controls to 0 — 12px plates, ~8–10px controls/rows.
Don't recolor, restyle, or replace the vault-wheel logomark.
